instructions:
Task: Compositional policy 002

Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action delete in context external; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role operator or auditor, except for action delete; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80. Action change in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role auditor or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Declared labels: deny, allow, review

Public input schema: {"enums":[{"name":"Role","values":["operator","auditor","guest"]},{"name":"Action","values":["inspect","change","delete"]},{"name":"Context","values":["internal","sandbox","external"]}],"records":[{"fields":[{"name":"role","type_name":"Role"},{"name":"action","type_name":"Action"},{"name":"context","type_name":"Context"},{"name":"risk","type_name":"Boolean3"}],"name":"Event"}]}

Requirements:
Critical means risk TRUE, or action delete in context external; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role operator or auditor, except for action delete; a trusted inspect prefers deny at priority 80.
Action change in context external prefers allow at priority 70.
Role auditor or context sandbox prefers review at priority 40.
Trusted cases forbid review.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Forbidden shortcuts:
Use every field named by a relevant rule.

dsl.final_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == delete) and (event.context == external))

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == external)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == operator) or ((event.role == auditor) and (event.action != delete))

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedInspect:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == inspect)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80

rule ChangeExternal:
    when (event.action == change) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AuditorOrSandbox:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReview:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.risk != FALSE)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((not (Critical(event))) and (not (UnknownExternal(event)))) and (not (Trusted(event)))
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch1:
    when (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.role == auditor)
    then require label = deny

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch2:
    when (((event.action == change) and (event.context == sandbox)) and (event.risk == FALSE)) and (event.role == operator)
    then require label = deny

rule SourceCounterexamplePatch3:
    when (event.context == internal) and (event.risk == FALSE)
    then require label = deny
